related.title: Bazel：動作快取鍵、隱藏輸入與可信寫入者
related.titleEn: Bazel: action-cache keys, hidden inputs and trusted writers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：15532800與0秒可重算，兩時區結果一致；報告仍保留排序負例以限制可重現性的結論。 交付archive-time.csv、兩時區封存差異與轉換規則；只用本地三個文字檔，不存取外部套件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 15532800 and zero seconds and obtain equal timezone-controlled results, retaining the ordering counterexample to delimit the reproducibility claim. Deliver archive-time.csv, the two-timezone archive comparison and conversion rule using three local text files with no external package retrieval.
related.difference: 建立20個建置動作描述，列宣告輸入、工具鏈、命令、環境及輸出摘要；另標記實際讀到但未納入契約的檔案或變數。
related.differenceEn: Build 20 action descriptors with declared inputs, toolchain, command, environment and output digests. Separately mark files or variables actually consumed but absent from the action contract, making hidden dependencies visible before analyzing cache reuse.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課ZIP實作採1980-01-01 UTC為下限315532800；有效時間取max(來源epoch,下限)，這是特定封存格式的轉換，不可回寫改變原始來源歷史。 來源epoch=300000000秒，ZIP下限315532800；本課只計因格式限制而增加的秒數，不宣稱來源真實發生於1980年。 調整量max(300000000,315532800)−300000000=15532800秒；來源改320000000時調整量0。
本課封閉性覆蓋率為已完整列出影響輸入的動作比例；只有覆蓋完整仍不足以證明寫入者可信，快取ACL與產物完整性另列關卡。 20個動作中15個輸入契約完整，5個缺少時區、工具版本或工作目錄依賴；每個缺口列出可重現的反例變數。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；修正其中3個動作後為18/20×100=90%，剩下2個仍不能宣稱封閉。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For the selected ZIP implementation use the 1980-01-01 UTC floor of 315532800. Effective timestamp is max(source epoch,floor), a format conversion that must not rewrite the original source history or be generalized to every archive format. Set source epoch to 300000000 seconds with ZIP floor 315532800. Calculate only the adjustment required by this representation, without claiming that the original source event actually occurred at the adjusted archive timestamp. Adjustment is max(300000000, 315532800)−300000000=15532800 seconds. With source epoch 320000000 the adjustment is zero, because the source already lies above the representation floor.

Define closure coverage as the fraction of actions whose influential inputs are fully declared. Complete closure alone does not authenticate a cache writer; write authorization and artifact integrity remain separate gates in the cache trust model. Fifteen of 20 actions have complete input contracts. Five omit timezone, tool version or working-directory dependencies, with a reproducible counterexample variable recorded for each omission rather than an unexplained nonhermetic label. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Repairing three actions gives 18/20×100=90 percent; the remaining two still prevent a claim of complete declared-input closure.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenTelemetry：停機積壓與恢復排空證據
related.titleEn: OpenTelemetry: outage backlog and recovery drain evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：15532800與0秒可重算，兩時區結果一致；報告仍保留排序負例以限制可重現性的結論。 交付archive-time.csv、兩時區封存差異與轉換規則；只用本地三個文字檔，不存取外部套件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 15532800 and zero seconds and obtain equal timezone-controlled results, retaining the ordering counterexample to delimit the reproducibility claim. Deliver archive-time.csv, the two-timezone archive comparison and conversion rule using three local text files with no external package retrieval.
related.difference: 繪製接收、入列、送出與丟棄四個計數邊界，以事件ID建立守恆帳本，另記重試到期及磁碟容量。
related.differenceEn: Map received, enqueued, exported and dropped counters, reconcile event IDs, and separately record retry expiration and disk capacity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課ZIP實作採1980-01-01 UTC為下限315532800；有效時間取max(來源epoch,下限)，這是特定封存格式的轉換，不可回寫改變原始來源歷史。 來源epoch=300000000秒，ZIP下限315532800；本課只計因格式限制而增加的秒數，不宣稱來源真實發生於1980年。 調整量max(300000000,315532800)−300000000=15532800秒；來源改320000000時調整量0。

恢復後淨排空率為輸出速率減新輸入；若差值不正，增加緩衝只能延後滿載。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成輸入每秒240筆，停機180秒，空佇列容量60000筆；恢復輸出每秒360筆，不計批次額外開銷。 積壓240×180=43200筆；排空時間43200/(360−240)=360秒；這是記錄數模型，不是Exporter批次設定值。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For the selected ZIP implementation use the 1980-01-01 UTC floor of 315532800. Effective timestamp is max(source epoch,floor), a format conversion that must not rewrite the original source history or be generalized to every archive format. Set source epoch to 300000000 seconds with ZIP floor 315532800. Calculate only the adjustment required by this representation, without claiming that the original source event actually occurred at the adjusted archive timestamp. Adjustment is max(300000000, 315532800)−300000000=15532800 seconds. With source epoch 320000000 the adjustment is zero, because the source already lies above the representation floor.

Net recovery drain rate is output minus continuing input; nonpositive surplus means buffering only delays saturation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Synthetic input is 240 records/s during a 180-second outage, with capacity 60000 records and recovered output 360 records/s. Backlog is 43200 records; draining takes 43200/(360−240)=360 seconds. These record counts are not exporter batch settings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
